IGUI_SFL_Off: Freshness restoration is disabled for this lunchbox.
IGUI_SFL_GlobalOff: Freshness restoration is disabled in sandbox settings.
IGUI_SFL_Rate: One fresh-life interval per %1 game hours.
IGUI_SFL_TimeScope: Only eligible directly stored food is restored. Recorded game-time intervals are verified before catch-up; real-world offline time is not counted.
IGUI_SFL_CraftReason_equipped: remove the source lunchbox from both hands
IGUI_SFL_CraftReason_modified_source: restore existing upgrades before using the source lunchbox as material
IGUI_SFL_CraftReason_missing_input: an input was moved or removed
IGUI_SFL_CraftReason_duplicate_input: a physical material was selected more than once
IGUI_SFL_CraftReason_unexpected_input: the selected inputs do not match this recipe
IGUI_SFL_Starting: Freshness restoration is preparing. Wait briefly, or resume the game if paused.
IGUI_SFL_RottenRemovalLimit: This world enables native rotten-food removal or its value is unknown; this box does not restore already rotten food.
IGUI_SFL_Unavailable: Lunchbox freshness restoration could not load. Reload the save.
IGUI_SFL_Stopped: Lunchbox freshness restoration is paused. It resumes when the save is loaded again.
IGUI_SFL_Error: Lunchbox freshness restoration stopped after an error. Save and reload to try again.
